description: This is a square Persian rug with intricate floral and geometric patterns. The central medallion is a deep blue surrounded by radiating golden-yellow patterns resembling paisley or leaves, outlined in a light blue and white intricate design. The border of the rug features elaborate motifs in deep reds, blues, and creams, adding a rich and traditional feel. The rug has fringed edges in white. The overall design evokes a sense of luxury and traditional craftsmanship, typical of high-quality hand-knotted carpets. Its detailed artistry makes it a focal point for any room.
